import { Component } from '@angular/core'; import { HttpClient } from '@angular/common/http'; @Component({ selector: 'app-contact-us', templateUrl: './contact-us.component.html', styleUrls: ['./contact-us.component.css'], }) export class ContactUsComponent { contact = { name: '', email: '', message: '', }; constructor(private http: HttpClient) {} submitMessage() { this.http .post('http://localhost:8080/api/contact', this.contact) .subscribe({ next: () => { alert('✅ Message sent successfully!'); this.contact = { name: '', email: '', message: '' }; // reset }, error: () => { alert('❌ Failed to send message. Please try again later.'); }, }); } }
